title: S23 · Compare Core Salesforce, Automotive Cloud, and a DMS

Подготовь только синтетические данные и исходное состояние упражнения. Открой comparison table Core Salesforce / Automotive Cloud / DMS. Here is our practical task. Compare the three options for the five synthetic requirements and identify the next decision-changing proof.

By the end, you should be able to show the result and explain how you checked it. Vehicle__c is not described as the installed Automotive Cloud Vehicle model. All options receive a fair comparison with operating consequences.

cues.label: 02 · The learning project is not an industry implementation

blocks.text: ЭКРАН. Раздел «The learning project is not an industry implementation». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

The SAM starter uses custom Vehicle__c and Test_Drive__c objects to teach Salesforce development. Automotive Cloud has its own documented industry data model and capabilities. Creating a custom object with a similar name does not install that product or reproduce its behavior, entitlements, interfaces, or support model. Current Salesforce material may use Agentforce Automotive branding while developer documentation still describes Automotive Cloud. Confirm the actual product, edition, features, and contractual scope under discussion. A name change is not evidence that every capability or license in an old article applies to a proposed purchase.

cues.label: 03 · Define fit and gap in concrete terms

blocks.text: ЭКРАН. Раздел «Define fit and gap in concrete terms». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

A fit is a requirement an option can satisfy under the relevant configuration and constraints. A gap is something missing, uncertain, or requiring extension. Northstar needs vehicle and stakeholder relationships, test-drive coordination, selected workshop history, dealer access, and integration with an existing DMS. Each requirement needs a representative scenario and acceptance condition. Core Salesforce customization may fit a narrow workflow and allow a small initial implementation. The organization also owns the long-term design, tests, upgrades, and support of those custom features. An industry product may supply useful domain structure and capabilities, but adoption can require data migration, configuration, licensing, and process change. Keeping a function in the DMS can preserve an established authoritative workflow while creating integration and user-experience responsibilities.

ЭКРАН · КОД. Открой пример «Synthetic fit-gap rows» рядом с ожидаемым результатом. Выделяй вход, решение и выход; не читай весь листинг вслух. Перед запуском используй prerequisites и точную команду из урока. Запиши фактический вывод, включая ошибку, если она возникла.

The example on screen is Synthetic fit-gap rows. Before running it, identify the input, the branch that makes the decision, and the result we expect. We will compare that expectation with the actual output.

cues.label: 04 · Compare total responsibility, not only initial coding

blocks.text: ЭКРАН. Раздел «Compare total responsibility, not only initial coding». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Use the same comparison columns for all options: functional fit, access model, integration ownership, data migration, release process, operational support, product availability, and cost categories. Cost categories include licensing, implementation, ongoing administration, custom maintenance, data movement, and training. Do not invent current prices or use an unsupported total to make one option appear cheapest. Migration deserves its own scenario. Mapping custom Vehicle__c records into an industry model can involve more than copying names and VIN values. Relationships, identifiers, historical ownership, downstream references, and reports may need redesign. Keep the source authoritative until a reviewed cutover proves the destination's correctness.

cues.label: 05 · Design a narrow evaluation without assuming a license

blocks.text: ЭКРАН. Раздел «Design a narrow evaluation without assuming a license». Продолжай показ подготовленного примера. Выдели входные данные и решение именно этого раздела. Не прокручивай целый урок вместо демонстрации. Если это аналитическое упражнение, заполняй его рабочую таблицу по одному решению.

Use official data-model documentation to map a small fictional scenario: one vehicle, Irina's relationship to it, one appointment request, and a DMS reservation. Mark which parts are directly supported, need configuration, need code, or remain uncertain. If an appropriate trial or licensed environment is available, execute only the agreed proof scenario and record the environment. An ordinary Trailhead Playground or Developer Edition does not automatically guarantee every industry feature. If you cannot access the required product, complete the fit-gap document and list the exact tests still needed. A diagram derived from documentation is useful evidence of analysis, but it is not a successful product implementation.
For the practical work, create a fit-gap table using the same columns and evidence standard for all options.

A course's convenient custom schema should not become a default recommendation for every automotive organization. Now pause the video and try the exercise yourself. Before you finish, answer this question in your own words. What is a fit-gap analysis?
ПРИ ЗАПИСИ. Пауза 4 секунды. Не показывай ответ раньше вопроса. Затем открой объяснение и сравни его с проверяемым результатом.

A structured comparison of requirements that an option satisfies, requires extending, cannot satisfy, or has not yet been verified to satisfy. Save your work with the expected and actual results. If a check was not run, say which one remains and what you would need to run it.
